statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The diagnosis codes are R55, G45.9, and R42
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to evaluate for intermittent conduction abnormalities or atrial fibrillation
